title: ClearDisk (this app)
summary: This app. It checks what's running every few seconds.
whyHigh: Briefly busy while it reads the process list. It checks less often when its window is closed.

title: Kernel (heat control)
summary: The core of macOS. When your Mac gets hot, it holds back other work to cool down.
whyHigh: High when your Mac is hot. It's cooling the Mac by keeping other apps off the CPU. Look at what's heating it up.

title: Screen drawing
summary: Draws every window, animation and display you see.
whyHigh: Busy with many open windows, external or scaled displays, transparency effects, or an app redrawing nonstop.

title: Process launcher
summary: Starts and supervises every other process on your Mac.
whyHigh: Rarely busy. Brief spikes happen when many apps or services start at once.

title: Login and session manager
summary: Manages your login session, the lock screen and logging out.
whyHigh: Brief activity at login or when locking. Sustained use usually points to a stuck login item.

title: Dock and Mission Control
summary: Runs the Dock, app switching and Mission Control.
whyHigh: Busy during Mission Control animations or with many Dock items updating badges.

title: Finder
summary: Shows your files, your desktop and folder windows.
whyHigh: Busy while copying files, making previews for big folders, or calculating folder sizes.

title: Menu bar items
summary: Runs parts of the menu bar, such as some status icons.
whyHigh: Usually idle. Spikes can come from a misbehaving menu bar extra.

title: Control Center
summary: Runs Control Center and many menu bar icons.
whyHigh: Busy when menu bar icons update often, like Now Playing or the screen recording indicator.

title: Notification Center
summary: Shows notifications and widgets.
whyHigh: Busy when widgets refresh or many notifications arrive at once.

title: System logging
summary: Collects log messages from every app and service.
whyHigh: Busy when an app writes huge amounts of log messages, often during a bug or crash loop.

title: User accounts directory
summary: Looks up user accounts, groups and passwords.
whyHigh: Busy at login, or on Macs joined to a company directory.

title: Network settings
summary: Tracks network settings and connection changes.
whyHigh: Busy when networks change often, such as flaky Wi-Fi or a VPN reconnecting.

title: Network names (DNS and Bonjour)
summary: Looks up web addresses and finds devices on your network.
whyHigh: Busy with many lookups, a crowded local network, or a VPN changing DNS settings.

title: Audio
summary: Handles all sound coming in and out of your Mac.
whyHigh: Busy while audio plays or records, especially with several apps or audio plug-ins at once.

title: Bluetooth
summary: Manages Bluetooth devices like AirPods, keyboards and mice.
whyHigh: Busy when pairing, with many devices connected, or with a device dropping in and out.

title: Wi-Fi
summary: Manages your Wi-Fi connection.
whyHigh: Busy while scanning for networks, roaming between access points, or holding on to a weak signal.

title: Keyboard, mouse and trackpad
summary: Handles input from your keyboard, mouse and trackpad.
whyHigh: Busy with high-rate gaming mice or apps that watch every keystroke or mouse movement.

title: Power management
summary: Handles sleep, battery and power settings.
whyHigh: Rarely busy. Spikes can happen around sleep and wake.

title: AirDrop and Handoff
summary: Runs AirDrop, Handoff and Universal Clipboard.
whyHigh: Busy during AirDrop transfers or when nearby Apple devices keep coming in and out of range.

title: System message bus
summary: Passes internal messages between apps and macOS.
whyHigh: Busy when an app floods the system with messages, usually because of a bug.

title: App settings
summary: Reads and saves settings for every app.
whyHigh: Busy when an app saves its settings far too often. Usually brief.

title: System event handler
summary: Reacts to events like network changes and devices being plugged in.
whyHigh: Busy when many events fire, such as a USB device reconnecting over and over.

title: Core services
summary: Keeps track of apps and which app opens which file.
whyHigh: Busy after installing or moving many apps.

title: App lifecycle manager
summary: Decides which apps and helpers may run, and how much they get.
whyHigh: Rarely busy. Spikes happen when many apps launch or quit at once.

title: Network health monitor
summary: Watches network performance to pick the best connection.
whyHigh: Busy when your network is unstable.

title: Privacy permissions
summary: Checks which apps may use your camera, files, screen and more.
whyHigh: Busy when apps ask for permissions often.

title: Security and keychain
summary: Handles passwords, certificates and encryption keys.
whyHigh: Busy when apps use the keychain heavily or check many certificates.

title: Keychain sync
summary: Syncs your passwords with iCloud Keychain.
whyHigh: Busy after signing in to iCloud or when many passwords change.

title: Certificate checks
summary: Checks that website and app certificates are valid.
whyHigh: Busy while browsing many sites or opening many apps for the first time.

title: App safety checks (Gatekeeper)
summary: Checks that apps are safe before they open.
whyHigh: Busy the first time you open newly downloaded apps, or after a macOS update.

title: Malware protection
summary: Apple's built-in malware scanner.
whyHigh: Busy while scanning new downloads, or after its malware definitions update.

title: Code signature checks
summary: Verifies that apps and code are signed and unchanged.
whyHigh: Busy when launching many apps, or developer tools that run lots of small programs.

title: Background downloads
summary: Downloads and uploads files for apps in the background.
whyHigh: Busy while apps download updates, podcasts, iCloud files or large media.

title: Push notifications
summary: Keeps the connection that delivers notifications from Apple.
whyHigh: Rarely busy. Spikes happen when your network changes.

title: File change tracker
summary: Records which files change, for Time Machine, Spotlight and sync apps.
whyHigh: Busy when many files change at once, such as builds, big copies or syncing.

title: Disk mounting
summary: Mounts and ejects disks and USB drives.
whyHigh: Busy when drives are plugged in, or when a disk keeps disconnecting.

title: Driver manager
summary: Loads drivers and system extensions.
whyHigh: Busy after installing drivers or a macOS update.

title: Software Update
summary: Checks for and downloads macOS updates.
whyHigh: Busy while downloading or preparing an update.
idleNote: Finishes when the update is ready

title: Time Machine
summary: Backs up your Mac with Time Machine.
whyHigh: Busy during backups, especially the first one or after many files change.

title: Background task scheduler
summary: Decides when background work like backups and indexing runs.
whyHigh: Rarely busy itself. It schedules other heavy work.

title: Storage cleanup
summary: Frees purgeable space when your disk gets full.
whyHigh: Busy when the disk is nearly full and macOS is clearing caches.

title: Crash reporter
summary: Writes a report when an app crashes.
whyHigh: Busy when an app keeps crashing. Check which app it is.

title: Hang reporter
summary: Records what an app was doing when it froze.
whyHigh: Busy right after an app hangs or shows the spinning beachball.

title: Video decoding
summary: Decodes video for apps that play it.
whyHigh: Busy while playing video, especially high resolution or several videos at once.

title: Video encoding
summary: Encodes video for screen recording, video calls and exports.
whyHigh: Busy during video calls, screen recording or video exports.

title: Graphics compiler
summary: Prepares graphics code for apps and games.
whyHigh: Busy the first time an app or game runs after an install or update.

title: App database
summary: Tracks installed apps and which app opens each file type.
whyHigh: Busy after installing or updating apps.

title: App icons
summary: Loads and caches app and file icons.
whyHigh: Busy after installing apps, or opening folders with many kinds of files.

title: App containers
summary: Manages the storage folders of sandboxed apps.
whyHigh: Busy after installing or updating sandboxed apps.

title: On-device speech recognition
summary: Turns speech into text for dictation and Live Captions.
whyHigh: Busy while dictating, or with Live Captions turned on.

title: Spotlight
summary: Runs Spotlight search and decides what to index.
whyHigh: Busy after a macOS update, a large file copy, or plugging in a drive.

title: Spotlight file indexing
summary: Updates the search index for your files.
whyHigh: Busy after a macOS update, a large file copy, or plugging in a drive.

title: Spotlight file reader
summary: Reads the contents of files so Spotlight can search them.
whyHigh: Busy when many new or changed files need indexing, like builds or big downloads.

title: Spotlight file reader (older)
summary: Reads the contents of files so Spotlight can search them.
whyHigh: Busy when many new or changed files need indexing.

title: Spotlight bulk indexer
summary: Indexes many files at once for Spotlight.
whyHigh: Busy right after a macOS update or when a large folder appears.

title: Spotlight app content
summary: Indexes content inside apps, like Mail and Notes, for search.
whyHigh: Busy after setting up Mail or when apps add lots of searchable content.

title: Spotlight suggestions
summary: Builds Spotlight's knowledge for suggestions and smarter results.
whyHigh: Busy after a macOS update while it rebuilds. Calms down on its own.

title: Photos analysis
summary: Finds faces, objects and memories in your Photos library.
whyHigh: Busy after importing many photos or a macOS update. It mostly works while your Mac is idle and plugged in.

title: Media analysis
summary: Analyzes photos and videos for search and Live Text.
whyHigh: Busy after importing many photos or videos, or after a macOS update.

title: Photos library
summary: Manages your Photos library and iCloud Photos sync.
whyHigh: Busy while importing photos or syncing with iCloud Photos.

title: iCloud Drive sync
summary: Syncs your iCloud Drive files.
whyHigh: Busy while uploading or downloading many files, or when a sync gets stuck.

title: iCloud sync
summary: Syncs app data with iCloud, like Notes, Reminders and Safari.
whyHigh: Busy after signing in, or when many changes sync at once.

title: Cloud file provider
summary: Connects Finder to cloud storage like iCloud Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive.
whyHigh: Busy while cloud folders sync, or Finder shows many cloud files.

title: Siri Suggestions
summary: Learns your app habits to power suggestions.
whyHigh: Busy after a macOS update while it rebuilds what it knows. Calms down within a day.

title: Siri and Shortcuts actions
summary: Indexes app actions for Siri and Shortcuts.
whyHigh: Busy after updates, or after installing apps with many Shortcuts actions.

title: Suggestions
summary: Finds contacts, events and suggestions in Mail and Messages.
whyHigh: Busy after setting up Mail or receiving many messages.

title: Usage history
summary: Stores what you use, for suggestions and Screen Time.
whyHigh: Rarely busy. Spikes happen after updates.

title: Significant locations
summary: Learns places you visit for suggestions and reminders.
whyHigh: Rarely busy.

title: Location services
summary: Works out your Mac's location for apps that ask.
whyHigh: Busy when apps ask for your location often.

title: Siri
summary: Handles Siri requests.
whyHigh: Busy while you use Siri or dictation.

title: Web page (Safari or an app)
summary: Runs one web page for Safari, Mail or another app.
whyHigh: A busy web page, often with video, ads or a web app left open.

title: Web networking
summary: Handles downloads and connections for Safari and web views.
whyHigh: Busy while pages or apps download a lot of data.

title: Web graphics
summary: Draws web pages and video for Safari and web views.
whyHigh: Busy with video, animations or many open tabs.

title: Messages and FaceTime
summary: Sends and receives iMessages and FaceTime calls.
whyHigh: Busy after signing in, or syncing a large Messages history.

title: Reminders
summary: Syncs and schedules your reminders.
whyHigh: Busy after signing in or syncing many reminders.

title: Music library
summary: Manages your Music and TV library.
whyHigh: Busy after importing music or syncing your library.

title: Virtual machine
summary: A virtual computer run by an app like Docker, OrbStack, UTM or Parallels.
whyHigh: Busy whenever the virtual machine is working. Quit the app that runs it when you don't need it.

title: Docker
summary: Runs Docker Desktop's engine.
whyHigh: Busy while containers run or images build. Quit Docker Desktop when you're not using it.

title: Node.js
summary: Runs JavaScript programs, often developer tools or local servers.
whyHigh: Busy while a dev server, build or script is running.

title: Google Software Update
summary: Keeps Chrome and other Google apps up to date.
whyHigh: Brief activity while checking for or installing updates.

title: Microsoft AutoUpdate
summary: Keeps Office and other Microsoft apps up to date.
whyHigh: Brief activity while checking for or installing updates.

title: Adobe background services
summary: Runs Creative Cloud sync, updates and licensing.
whyHigh: Busy while Creative Cloud syncs files or installs updates.

title: Dropbox background services
summary: Keeps Dropbox up to date and syncing.
whyHigh: Busy while Dropbox syncs many files.

title: Zoom background services
summary: Keeps Zoom up to date.
whyHigh: Brief activity while checking for updates.
